dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'C' and 'O' shaped structures with light-grey perimeters and soft inward gradients. Perimeter geometry is irregular and diffuse, appearing most clearly in the upper-medial and anterior-dorsal regions against the darker charcoal base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, dark, high-intensity punctate clusters concentrated primarily in the upper-left quadrant. These spots appear as solid, low-intensity pixel groups lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent ring-like structures in the mid-dorsal section form an elongated, irregular trapezoidal spatial relationship.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, distinct reddish-brown point-source marks are visible in the lower-central and mid-dorsal areas. A faint, shallow linear indentation is visible on the upper skin surface near the right boundary of the central mass.
other_distinctive_markers: The pelt exhibits a complex reticulated pattern where the boundaries of the macro-annuli merge to form a continuous, interlocking mosaic or mesh-like topology.
